description: 15 malicious JetBrains Marketplace plugins discovered stealing API keys and developer credentials. Reported by Aikido Security. These plugins were distributed via the official JetBrains Marketplace and removed after disclosure.

plugins.name: AI Assistant Pro
plugins.threat: Exfiltrates .env files and shell history to remote C2 server

plugins.name: DevMate Copilot+
plugins.threat: Reads IDE keychain, sends credentials to attacker infrastructure

plugins.name: Code Helper AI
plugins.threat: Collects API keys from open editor files and environment variables

plugins.name: IDE Turbo Booster
plugins.threat: Injects malicious code into project files on save, steals git credentials

plugins.name: SmartDev API Vault
plugins.threat: Captures clipboard contents and .env file values, exfiltrates via DNS

plugins.name: Smart Code Completion AI
plugins.threat: Backdoors the project on first open, exfiltrates secrets

plugins.name: DevPilot Productivity Suite
plugins.threat: Reads AWS credentials file, sends to remote server

plugins.name: CodeBuddy Enterprise
plugins.threat: Man-in-the-middle on outgoing HTTP requests to capture auth tokens

plugins.name: AI Studio Pair Programmer
plugins.threat: Steals JetBrains account session tokens and IDE license keys

plugins.name: DevHawk Secret Manager
plugins.threat: Ironically, reads all secrets from configured vaults and exfiltrates them

plugins.name: QuantumDev Code Lens AI
plugins.threat: Harvests GitHub/GitLab tokens from IDE VCS settings

plugins.name: Neurode IntelliFlow
plugins.threat: Persistence via IDE startup task, exfiltrates SSH private keys

plugins.name: Synapse Code Optimizer Pro
plugins.threat: Reads .npmrc, .pypirc, and cloud provider credential files

plugins.name: CodeRift AI Agent
plugins.threat: Executes remote payloads downloaded from attacker-controlled CDN

plugins.name: Nexus DevOps Companion
plugins.threat: Intercepts Kubernetes kubeconfig and cloud CLI credentials
